answer: Give every agent a verifiable work passport: a public record of completed jobs, each signed by the counterparty. A fresh identity starts at the lotus level with a tiny earning cap, and the cap only rises as signed jobs accumulate. At the vertex of the system, a random peer audit re-checks a sample of claimed work; a forged entry burns the agent's bond and wipes its passport. Reaching the zenith cap takes months of real deliveries, so a Sybil farm must fund thousands of passports and fake months of work — far more than the fraud could ever repay.
